title: Warehouse Shift Supervisor
description: Niagara Frontier Distribution is hiring a Warehouse Shift Supervisor for our Buffalo DC. Supervise 20 associates on second shift, manage labour and productivity in Manhattan WMS, and lead safety. Requirements: 3+ years warehouse supervision, forklift certification, WMS experience. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States; we do not sponsor work visas (including TN) now or in the future.

title: Operations Manager - 3PL Warehouse
description:
Copperline 3PL Solutions is hiring an Operations Manager for our Mississauga building. You will manage two shift supervisors and roughly 60 associates, own the site labour budget, lead client business reviews, and drive continuous improvement projects.

Requirements: 8+ years of warehouse experience including 3+ years managing supervisors or a multi-shift operation; 3PL experience; strong P&L and budgeting knowledge; Manhattan WMS an asset; Lean Green Belt preferred; university degree or college diploma in supply chain.

title: Dental Office Receptionist
description: Busy family dental practice in Woodbridge seeks a full-time Dental Receptionist. Book appointments, check in patients, submit insurance claims, and handle billing. Experience with ABELDent or Dentrix and knowledge of dental terminology required. Dental office experience of at least 1 year required. Some evenings and Saturdays.

title: Health & Safety Coordinator - Distribution
description:
Lakeshore Hardware Group is looking for a Health & Safety Coordinator to support three distribution centres in the west GTA.

You will conduct workplace inspections, support JHSCs, investigate incidents, deliver WHMIS and lift truck safety training, track WSIB claims, and help supervisors build safe work procedures.

Requirements: 3+ years of health and safety or warehouse operations experience; JHSC Certification; working knowledge of the OHSA; strong training delivery. A college certificate in OHS or CRSP designation is an asset.

title: Supervisor, Inbound Receiving
description:
Summit Auto Parts Canada - Markham DC

Supervisor, Inbound Receiving (Days)

Lead a team of 16 receivers and putaway drivers. Schedule dock appointments with carriers, verify ASNs against receipts, resolve overages, shortages and damages, and keep dock-to-stock under 24 hours. Partner with inventory control on cycle counts.

Must have: 3+ years supervising in a warehouse; forklift certified; WHMIS; WMS and RF experience; ability to lift 50 lbs occasionally. Nice to have: Manhattan, SAP or JDA; Lean Yellow Belt.

Monday-Friday 6:00 a.m. - 2:30 p.m.

title: Payroll Administrator
description: Clearpath Payroll Services is hiring a remote Payroll Administrator to manage end-to-end payroll for 25 Canadian client companies. Process bi-weekly payrolls, remittances, ROEs, T4s and year-end reconciliations. Must hold the Payroll Compliance Practitioner (PCP) designation and have 3+ years of Canadian payroll experience. Open to candidates in Canada.

title: Distribution Centre Supervisor in Training - Summer Student Co-op
description: Summer 2027 co-op opportunity (16 weeks). Shadow our distribution centre supervisors, help with cycle counts and reports, and complete a small improvement project. Applicants must be currently enrolled full-time in a college or university supply chain or business program and returning to school in September. No prior experience required.

title: Inventory Control Analyst
description:
Inventory Control Analyst - Brampton DC

Own inventory accuracy for a 250,000 sq ft building. Plan and audit cycle counts, investigate variances, reconcile WMS and ERP balances, and report shrink and accuracy KPIs to leadership.

Requirements

  • 3+ years in inventory control or warehouse operations
  • Strong Excel (pivots, lookups); Power BI an asset
  • Manhattan WMS experience preferred
  • College diploma in supply chain or related field

title: Warehouse Supervisor - SAP EWM Site
description:
Brightwater Appliances Canada is looking for a Warehouse Supervisor at our Vaughan distribution centre. Supervise a day shift of 16 associates handling large appliances for retail and home delivery.

This site runs SAP EWM and the supervisor acts as the shift super-user: troubleshooting warehouse tasks, handling units and wave errors, and training staff on new transactions. Strong SAP EWM experience is highly preferred; candidates from other WMS platforms will need to complete our 8-week SAP training program.

Also required: 4+ years of warehouse experience including 2 years supervising, forklift (counterbalance with clamp attachment an asset), WHMIS.

title: Warehouse Shift Supervisor
description:
Warehouse Shift Supervisor (English-speaking)

Lead a team of 22 in our Rotterdam e-commerce fulfilment centre on rotating shifts. Manhattan WMS experience is a plus.

Requirements: 3+ years warehouse supervision, reach truck certificate, fluent English.

This is an on-site position in Rotterdam, the Netherlands. Candidates must already be based in the Netherlands; we do not offer relocation.

title: Accounts Payable Clerk
description: Meridian Plastics is looking for an Accounts Payable Clerk to process vendor invoices, match POs and receiving documents, run weekly cheque and EFT payments, and reconcile vendor statements. Requirements: 2+ years of AP experience, accounting diploma, strong Excel, experience with Sage 300 or similar. Monday to Friday, 8:30 a.m. - 4:30 p.m.

title: Fulfillment Operations Team Lead (Nights)
description:
Parcelwise Canada operates e-commerce fulfillment buildings for marketplace sellers. Our Team Leads are the front-line people leaders in the building.

As Fulfillment Operations Team Lead on nights, you will be accountable for a team of 20-25 associates in the pick, pack and ship departments. You will plan headcount for the shift, run start-up meetings, track rate and quality, coach underperformers, approve timecards and handle discipline with HR. You will also own safety on your floor: powered equipment audits, near-miss reporting and housekeeping.

What you need: 3+ years leading teams in a warehouse or distribution setting, forklift certification, WHMIS, working knowledge of a WMS such as Manhattan, and comfort with Excel dashboards. Nights, Sunday to Wednesday, 4 x 10 hours.

title: Shift Supervisor - Cafe (Union Station)
description: Kettle & Crumb Coffee Co. is hiring a Shift Supervisor for our busy Union Station cafe. Open or close the store, lead baristas during the shift, handle cash, deal with customer concerns and keep the cafe clean and stocked. 1+ year barista or food service experience, Food Handler certificate, availability for 5:30 a.m. openings. Free drinks on shift and a growth path to Assistant Store Manager.

title: Warehouse Supervisor - Afternoon Shift
description: Granite Ridge Beverages, Vaughan warehouse. Afternoon shift supervisor needed (3:00 p.m. - 11:30 p.m.). Supervise a team of about 18 shippers, receivers and forklift operators, coordinate loading for 40+ daily routes, conduct pre-shift safety talks, and keep inventory accurate. Must have 3+ years of warehouse supervision, forklift certification and WHMIS; experience with a WMS and RF guns required. Benefits, pension and product allowance.

title: Transport Supervisor - AZ Licence Required
description:
Credit Valley Cartage is hiring a Transport Supervisor to oversee 30 city and regional drivers out of our Mississauga terminal. You will plan routes, manage hours of service, run driver safety meetings, and cover routes yourself when needed.

Mandatory: valid Ontario AZ licence with a clean driver abstract and CVOR knowledge; 3+ years driving tractor-trailers; 2+ years supervising. Applicants without an AZ licence will not be considered.

title: Senior Director, Network Fulfilment Operations
description:
Northern Harbour Retail Corp. is seeking a Senior Director, Network Fulfilment Operations to lead our six Canadian distribution and fulfilment centres (2,400 employees). You will own a $220M operating budget, set network strategy, lead automation investments and report to the SVP Supply Chain.

Requirements: 15+ years of progressive supply chain leadership, including 7+ years leading multiple sites through general managers; proven P&L ownership; experience leading large automation programs; MBA or engineering degree preferred.

title: Logistics Coordinator
description:
Fernhill Freight Brokerage is hiring a remote Logistics Coordinator. Candidates must be based in Canada or the United States and able to work Eastern Time hours.

You will book LTL and FTL shipments, track loads, update customers, chase PODs and resolve delivery exceptions with carriers and warehouses. You will work in our TMS all day and in Excel for reporting.

We are looking for 2+ years of logistics, warehouse or transportation experience, strong communication skills and comfort juggling 30-50 active loads. Warehouse or shipping and receiving background is a plus.

title: Line Cook - Full Time
description: The Copper Kettle Bistro on The Queensway is hiring a full-time Line Cook. Work the grill and saute stations, prep ingredients, follow recipes and plating standards, and keep the kitchen clean. 2+ years of line cook experience and a Food Handler certificate required. Evenings and weekends. Staff meal every shift.

title: Logistics Coordinator - Warehouse Network
description:
Bluestem Commerce is hiring a remote Logistics Coordinator to support our network of third-party warehouses. Coordinate inbound appointments, monitor inventory levels across sites, follow up on order exceptions and report weekly KPIs.

This role is open to US residents only. Candidates must live in the United States; we cannot hire in Canada or other countries.

Requirements: 3+ years in warehouse or logistics operations, WMS experience, strong Excel.

title: Distribution Supervisor (Days)
description:
At Trillium Office Products, we believe a great workday starts with having the right tools. Since 1988 we have been the go-to supplier for schools, hospitals and small businesses across Ontario, delivering everything from printer paper to ergonomic furniture, usually by the next morning. We are a family-run company that has grown to more than 600 employees without losing the small-team feel: our founders still walk the floor every week, and we know each other by name.

We are proud of our culture. Our team enjoys a company-paid benefits plan, a generous employee purchase program, summer barbecues, a holiday party that people actually look forward to, and a recognition program where colleagues nominate each other for monthly awards. We have also committed to cutting delivery emissions in half by 2030 and have already moved a third of our city routes to electric vans.

About the position
Reporting to the Operations Manager, the Distribution Supervisor leads our day shift team of 15-20 associates in a 180,000 sq ft North York facility.

Requirements

  • 4+ years in a distribution or warehouse environment, including 2+ years supervising
  • Forklift certification and WHMIS
  • Experience with WMS and RF scanning (Manhattan an asset)
  • Strong Excel and communication skills

title: Order Picker - Part-Time Weekends
description:
Order Picker (Part-Time)

Saturday and Sunday, 7:00 a.m. - 3:30 p.m.

  • Pick orders accurately using an RF scanner
  • Meet productivity targets
  • Follow all safety rules

No experience necessary. Students welcome. Training on RF scanners and pallet jacks is provided during your first two shifts, and you will work alongside an experienced buddy until you are comfortable.

title: Fulfilment Operations Analyst
description:
Tidewater Retail Group is looking for a remote Fulfilment Operations Analyst to monitor performance across our UK fulfilment partners.

  • Analyse throughput, accuracy and labour data
  • Support partner warehouses with process improvements
  • Build weekly reports for the operations leadership team

Location: remote within the UK only. Candidates must be UK residents with the right to work in the UK.

Warehouse supervision experience and WMS knowledge strongly valued.

title: Warehouse Supervisor
description:
Bayfront Housewares is seeking a Warehouse Supervisor for our Meadowvale DC. You will supervise a day shift team of 15-20 associates handling inbound containers and outbound retail orders, plan labour, run cycle counts, and drive safety and productivity.

Requirements: 5+ years in warehousing including 2+ years supervising; forklift certification; WHMIS; WMS experience (Manhattan or similar); strong Excel. Monday to Friday, 7:00 a.m. - 3:30 p.m. Benefits and RRSP matching.

title: Warehouse Supervisor - Nights
description:
Kestrel Home Goods is hiring a Warehouse Supervisor for the night shift (Sunday to Thursday, 10:00 p.m. - 6:30 a.m.) at our 280,000 sq ft distribution centre near Hwy 401 and Dixie Rd.

What you will do:
- Lead a team of 18-24 warehouse associates and lead hands across receiving, picking, packing and shipping
- Plan labour at shift start and adjust through the night based on wave volume
- Monitor productivity, accuracy and safety KPIs and report at the morning handover
- Coach, train and hold team members accountable; complete attendance and performance documentation
- Lead incident investigations and support the Joint Health and Safety Committee

What you bring:
- 5+ years of warehouse experience, including 2+ years in a supervisory role
- Valid forklift certification and WHMIS training
- Experience with a WMS; Manhattan is a strong asset
- Comfortable with Excel and daily KPI reporting
- Able to work nights and occasional Saturdays during peak

How your night looks:
10:00 p.m. - start-up meeting with your leads, review of the wave plan and staffing gaps
10:30 p.m. - 2:00 a.m. - floor walks, labour moves between zones, exception handling in the WMS
2:00 a.m. - 5:30 a.m. - trailer loading, replenishment for the day shift, cycle count tasks
5:30 a.m. - 6:30 a.m. - shift report and handover to the day supervisor

Who you will work with: you will report to the Night Operations Manager and work closely with the inventory control, transportation and maintenance teams. Two other supervisors run the night shift alongside you, each owning a section of the building, and you will cover for each other during vacations.

We offer a night shift premium, benefits from day one, RRSP matching, an employee discount, paid JHSC certification and a clear path to Operations Manager for supervisors who want to grow.

title: Warehouse Supervisor
description: Pennine Distribution is recruiting a Warehouse Supervisor for our Trafford Park site. Lead a team of 20 operatives on a 4-on/4-off shift pattern, manage KPIs and drive safety. Requirements: 3+ years supervising in a warehouse, counterbalance/reach truck licence, WMS experience. This is a fully on-site role in Manchester, UK; relocation support is not available.

title: Customs Compliance Supervisor
description:
Pearson Gateway Logistics operates a bonded warehouse near Toronto Pearson Airport. We are hiring a Customs Compliance Supervisor to lead a team of 6 customs and bonded inventory clerks.

You will oversee CBSA release processes, bonded inventory controls, sufferance warehouse records, and audits.

Requirements: Certified Customs Specialist (CCS) designation is required; licensed customs broker (LCB) is an asset. 3+ years in customs brokerage or bonded warehouse compliance; knowledge of CARM and the Customs Act.

title: Distribution Centre Shift Supervisor
description:
We are hiring a Distribution Centre Shift Supervisor for our retail DC in Brampton (front-store merchandise, not regulated pharmaceuticals).

  • Lead 20+ associates on a rotating day/night schedule
  • Manage waves and labour in Manhattan WMS
  • Monitor KPIs and ensure trucks leave on time
  • Champion a strong safety culture

You have: 3+ years supervising in a DC, forklift certification, WHMIS, and WMS experience.

title: Transportation Dispatcher
description:
Credit Valley Cartage is a regional LTL carrier with 80 trucks. We need a Dispatcher for our Mississauga terminal (Monday - Friday, 5:00 a.m. - 1:30 p.m.).

Duties: assign city pickups and deliveries to drivers, monitor ELD and GPS, respond to customer calls, coordinate with the dock on cross-dock loads, and keep driver hours of service compliant.

Requirements: 2+ years in dispatch, logistics or shipping/receiving; strong multitasking; Excel; no driver's licence class beyond G required. TMW or similar dispatch software experience is an asset.

title: Distribution Centre Supervisor
description:
Distribution Centre Supervisor - Rotating Shifts

Ridgeway Grocery Distribution supplies 140 independent grocery stores across Ontario from our Brampton DC.

Responsibilities

  • Supervise a team of approximately 22 selectors, loaders and receivers
  • Release and monitor waves in Manhattan WMS; manage replenishment and exceptions
  • Ensure trucks depart on time and loads are built correctly
  • Enforce safe operation of powered equipment and food safety practices
  • Handle scheduling, vacation planning and attendance

Qualifications

  • 3+ years supervising in a warehouse or DC
  • Forklift certification (counterbalance and reach)
  • WHMIS 2015
  • Manhattan WMS experience preferred
  • Willing to work a rotating 4-on/4-off day/night schedule

Comprehensive benefits, pension plan and shift premiums.

title: Warehouse Operations Supervisor
description:
Lakeview Apparel Fulfilment ships online orders for six Canadian clothing brands. We are adding a Warehouse Operations Supervisor to our Etobicoke site.

You will:
* Supervise about 20 pickers, packers and returns processors (days, with rotating Saturdays in Q4)
* Use Manhattan WMS to manage waves, short picks and replenishment
* Track UPH, accuracy and same-day ship rate and act on gaps
* Run onboarding for seasonal temps during peak
* Partner with HR on attendance, coaching and discipline

You have:
* 5+ years in warehousing, 2+ as a supervisor or shift lead
* Forklift certification and WHMIS
* Manhattan WMS or similar system experience
* Solid Excel skills

Hybrid is not available; this is an on-site role.

title: Warehouse Supervisor - Bilingual (French/English)
description:
Our Mississauga DC serves retail stores across Ontario and Quebec. We are hiring a bilingual Warehouse Supervisor to lead a team of 18 and act as the main contact for our Quebec store network and Montreal head office.

  • Supervise day shift operations, labour planning and safety
  • Communicate daily with Quebec stores and carriers in French

Requirements

  • Fluent French and English, spoken and written (mandatory; language assessment part of the process)
  • 3+ years warehouse supervision
  • Forklift certification and WHMIS

title: Warehouse Supervisor Recruiter - Staffing Sales (Commission)
description:
TalentBridge Staffing places warehouse supervisors, forklift operators and general labour across the GTA. We are looking for a Recruiter / Account Manager to source candidates and win new client accounts.

You will cold-call logistics companies, build job orders, screen candidates by phone, and hit weekly placement and revenue targets. Previous sales or agency recruitment experience is required; warehouse knowledge is helpful but not required. Bachelor's degree in HR or business preferred.

title: Distribution Centre Supervisor
description: Kowhai Wholesale is looking for a Distribution Centre Supervisor at our East Tamaki DC in Auckland. Supervise a team of 18 across receiving and dispatch, manage rosters and keep the site safe. Requirements: 3+ years supervising in a DC, forklift licence (F endorsement), WMS experience. On-site in Auckland, New Zealand; applicants must already live in New Zealand.

title: Warehouse Supervisor
description:
For more than sixty years, Greenleaf Grocers Co-operative has been owned by the independent grocers it serves. What started as a handful of family stores pooling their buying power in the east end of Toronto has grown into a co-operative of 210 members from Windsor to Kingston, all of them proudly local. Every dollar of surplus goes back to our members, and every member has a vote on how we grow. Our people are at the heart of that story. We were one of the first distributors in the province to offer a living wage to every employee, and we keep investing in the things that matter: a defined benefit pension, full health and dental coverage from your first day, tuition support, a paid volunteer day, and a staff food bank partnership that has delivered more than two million meals. Our Scarborough campus recently finished a solar roof and an electric yard-truck program, and we are proud that our team voted us a top employer five years in a row.

The role
As Warehouse Supervisor you will lead a team of about 20 associates on the day shift (6:00 a.m. - 2:30 p.m.), balancing selection, replenishment and shipping so member orders leave complete and on time.

What we need from you
- 5+ years of warehouse experience, 2+ in a supervisory position
- Valid forklift certification; WHMIS
- Hands-on experience with a WMS (we run Manhattan)
- Strong coaching and conflict resolution skills
- Ability to work occasional weekends during holiday peaks

title: Warehouse Supervisor - Defence Logistics
description:
Ironside Defence Services manages spare parts warehousing for a federal defence contract at Downsview. We are hiring a Warehouse Supervisor to lead 15 associates on the day shift, manage controlled goods inventory and support audits.

Requirements: 3+ years warehouse supervision, forklift certification, WHMIS, WMS experience. Due to the terms of the federal contract, only Canadian citizens can be considered; permanent residents are not eligible. The successful candidate must obtain a Secret security clearance and register under the Controlled Goods Program.

title: Fleet Maintenance Supervisor
description: Peel Valley Transport is hiring a Fleet Maintenance Supervisor for our Brampton shop. Supervise 8 mechanics servicing 120 tractors and 300 trailers, schedule preventive maintenance, manage parts inventory and keep MTO safety inspections current. Requirements: valid 310T Truck and Coach Technician Certificate of Qualification (mandatory), MVIS inspection licence, 5+ years of heavy-duty repair experience, 2+ years supervising.

title: Pharmaceutical Distribution Supervisor
description:
Westmount Pharma Logistics distributes prescription drugs under a Health Canada Drug Establishment Licence. The Distribution Supervisor also acts as the alternate Qualified Person in Charge (QPIC) for the site.

Responsibilities: supervise a team of 14 in a temperature-controlled warehouse, ensure GDP/GUI-0069 compliance, manage deviations and cold chain excursions, and support Health Canada inspections.

Requirements: a university degree in a science discipline (pharmacy, chemistry, biology or related) is required by regulation for this position; 3+ years in pharmaceutical warehousing; GDP knowledge; forklift and WHMIS.

title: Inventory Planning Specialist
description: Nordlicht Logistics is hiring an Inventory Planning Specialist (remote). You will balance stock across 5 European warehouses, plan replenishment, and work with site supervisors on cycle count results. Requirements: 3+ years in inventory or warehouse operations, WMS experience, advanced Excel. This position is open only to candidates residing in the EU, working CET hours.

title: Shift Supervisor, Warehouse Operations
description:
Northstar Building Supply is looking for a Shift Supervisor for our Concord distribution warehouse (afternoon shift, 2:30 p.m. - 11:00 p.m., Monday to Friday). You will lead a team of 18 associates handling lumber, drywall and hardware for contractor and retail orders.

Key duties: assign work, check load quality, run cycle counts, maintain housekeeping and 5S standards, ensure all lift truck operators follow safe operating procedures, train new hires, and complete daily shift reports.

Requirements: minimum 4 years in a warehouse environment with at least 2 years leading a team; current forklift certification; WHMIS; experience with a warehouse management system and RF scanners; strong communication skills; Lean or 5S exposure is an asset. Health and dental benefits, profit sharing, and a safety boot allowance.

title: Production Supervisor - Food Manufacturing
description:
Golden Wheat Bakeries - Production Supervisor (Afternoons)

Supervise 25 line operators and sanitation staff on two bread lines. Ensure production targets, GMP and HACCP compliance, and food safety documentation. Coordinate with maintenance on downtime and with the warehouse on finished-goods transfers.

We are looking for: 3+ years supervising in manufacturing or a related operations environment, HACCP knowledge (training provided if needed), WHMIS, strong people skills. Food manufacturing experience preferred.

title: Operations Floor Lead - Inbound & Outbound
description:
Copperline 3PL Solutions - Vaughan site (Hwy 400 & Langstaff)

Position: Operations Floor Lead - Inbound & Outbound
Shift: rotating days/afternoons, 2 weeks each
Reports to: Site Operations Manager

The Floor Lead is the people supervisor for one shift. You will direct approx. 20 full-time and agency staff across receiving, putaway, picking and loading for our retail and CPG clients; build the labour plan; release work in Manhattan WMS; sign off on outbound loads; and complete incident reports, attendance tracking and performance reviews.

Requirements: 4+ years warehouse experience with 2+ years supervising; forklift certification (counterbalance, reach); WHMIS; Manhattan WMS strongly preferred; Health and safety committee experience is a plus.

Benefits after 3 months, shift premium on afternoons.

title: Vice President, Supply Chain & Logistics
description: Evergrove Foods Canada is recruiting a Vice President, Supply Chain & Logistics. Reporting to the CEO, you will lead procurement, planning, manufacturing logistics, distribution and transportation across Canada with a team of 450. Requirements: 15+ years in supply chain with 5+ years at director level or above, CPG experience, degree in business or engineering, CSCP or APICS certification preferred.

title: Shipping & Receiving Lead Hand
description: Danforth Specialty Foods is hiring a Shipping & Receiving Lead Hand for our East York warehouse. Lead a crew of 4-5, check in inbound deliveries, build outbound orders for restaurants and grocers, operate forklift and pallet jack, and keep paperwork accurate. Requirements: 2+ years shipping and receiving, forklift certification, WHMIS, ability to work in a cooler environment. Monday to Friday days.

title: Warehouse Management Systems Developer (Java)
description:
Orbitline builds cloud warehouse management software used by 300 distribution centres. We are hiring a backend developer to work on our wave planning and labour modules.

  • 3+ years of professional Java / Spring Boot development
  • Experience with PostgreSQL, Kafka and REST APIs
  • Computer science degree or equivalent
  • Warehouse domain knowledge is a bonus

Hybrid, 2 days a week in our King West office.

title: General Labourer - Picking & Packing
description: Immediate openings for General Labourers in Brampton. Pick and pack orders, label boxes, load trucks and keep the work area clean. No experience needed, training provided. Must be able to lift 50 lbs and stand for 8 hours. Steel-toe boots required. Day, afternoon and night shifts available. Weekly pay.

title: Supervisor, Warehouse Operations
description: Queensway Electronics Distribution is looking for a Supervisor, Warehouse Operations to lead a night shift of 20 associates at our Etobicoke DC. Responsibilities include labour planning, wave management in Manhattan WMS, high-value inventory controls, coaching, attendance and safety. Requirements: 5 years warehouse experience including 2 years supervising, forklift certification, WHMIS, strong attention to detail. Night shift premium applies.

title: Commercial Leasing Associate - Industrial
description: Harrowgate Realty Advisors is growing its industrial leasing team. As a Leasing Associate you will prospect tenants for warehouse and logistics properties across the GTA, prepare market reports, tour clients through buildings, and support lease negotiations. A valid Ontario real estate salesperson registration (RECO) is required. Knowledge of the industrial market and warehousing operations is a plus.

title: Shift Supervisor - Fulfilment
description:
Arcadia Outdoor Gear was founded by two canoe guides who were tired of gear that fell apart halfway through a portage. Twenty years later we outfit hundreds of thousands of paddlers, hikers and campers every season, and we still test every product in Algonquin before it goes on sale. Our customers trust us to get their gear to them before the long weekend, and that promise lives in our Brampton fulfilment centre.

Life at Arcadia comes with real perks: a $1,000 annual gear allowance, an extra paid "trail day" each summer, group benefits with a health spending account, an RRSP match up to 5%, free on-site parking, and a subsidised cafeteria. We run employee canoe trips every August and donate 1% of sales to protecting Canadian watersheds. We are growing fast and we promote from within whenever we can.

The opportunity: we are looking for a Shift Supervisor to lead our night team (Monday - Thursday, 6:00 p.m. - 4:30 a.m.).

Responsibilities
- Supervise roughly 20 associates and 2 leads across picking, packing and outbound
- Manage wave release and exceptions in Manhattan WMS
- Keep the floor safe and the shift on plan

Requirements
- 3+ years of warehouse supervision
- Forklift certified, WHMIS trained
- Manhattan WMS experience preferred
- Available for night shifts and peak-season overtime
